content.comment_body: Has anyone successfully connected a [product_name] controller to a Variable Frequency Drive? If so, could you share an example?

It's difficult to provide a general answer to this question. Most inverters usually feature an RS485 interface that supports Modbus RTU. To connect with a [product_name] controller, you need an inverter with a LAN connector that supports Modbus TCP/IP, or alternatively, a gateway to convert Modbus RTU to Modbus TCP.

Hello [user_name], All [product_name] controllers with [article_no] support Ethernet TCP/IP using the S7 protocol. Since the release of version [version_no], Modbus TCP/IP is also supported. You did not specify which type of communication protocol you intend to use. Based on your post in a similar topic about Modbus TCP, I assume you are interested in Modbus TCP/IP. As a note, it's best not to post the same question multiple times.
